---
title: "What is the chance of exactly k successes in n independent trials?"
---

## What the question asks

What is the chance of exactly k successes in n independent trials?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Identify number of trials n, success probability p, and target k.

2. Check n and k are whole numbers with 0 <= k <= n.

3. Run dbinom(k,size=n,prob=p).

## Runnable example

```{r}
n <- 10; p <- 0.3; k <- 3
answer <- dbinom(k,size=n,prob=p)
print(answer)
```

## Interpret the result

For ten independent trials with success probability 0.3, dbinom(3,10,0.3) gives about 0.267 for exactly three successes.

## Check before using your own data

If independence or constant probability is implausible, do not use the binomial model without justification.
